newsitem.title: USA: MidAmerican sees 515 MW Iowa unit up today.
newsitem.headline: MidAmerican sees 515 MW Iowa unit up today.

text.p: MidAmerican Energy Co expected a 515 megawatt (MW) unit at the coal-fired Neal Generating Station would return to operation later today, the company said Wednesday.
The Neal unit was shut last weekend to repair a boiler tube leak, a company spokesman said.
Neal unit 3 is one of three units in the Neal "north" facility. The other two units: Neal 1 and 2 are rated at 135 and 300 MW, respectively.
A 624 MW Neal unit 4 is located a mile south of the northern units which are 15 miles south of Sioux City, Iowa, along the Missouri River.
The operation of Neal units 1, 2 and 4 were not affected by the current outage, the spokesman said.
MidAmerican, the operator of the Neal units, wholly owns units 1 and 2, and has a 72 percent stake in unit 3 and just under 41 percent in unit 4.
